what.text: This page follows refugees from Poland living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 494 Polish refugees in Germany, 36.1% of all refugees from Poland.
Germany is the largest host of Polish refugees, followed by Canada, Denmark and Sweden.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Poland, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2006.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 15182 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 18265, at the end of 2005, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
